stories.headline: Massie files 8 impeachment articles against Hegseth; House vote by Wednesday
stories.summary: Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) reintroduced eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Nov. 9 as a privileged measure, forcing a House floor vote within two legislative days (by Nov. 11) unless Republicans kill it by majority motion. Three charges cite Iran War Powers Resolution issues; others cite alleged drug-boat strikes, Maduro capture, and Yemen. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries said Sunday he is a hard yes. Hegseth scheduled a Pentagon press conference for Tuesday morning. Same day, Trump told reporters the Iran war is militarily effectively over (AP).

quickFacts: Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) **reintroduced eight articles of impeachment** against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Monday, Nov. 9. ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/thomas-massie-pete-hegseth-impeachment-house-defense-rcna597989); [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/09/nx-s1-6034483/thomas-massie-impeachment-pete-hegseth); [Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/11/09/hegseth-impeachment-effort-begins-house-focused-iran-war/))

He filed the measure as **privileged** under House rules, which forces a floor vote within **two legislative days** — by **Wednesday, Nov. 11** — unless Republicans kill it with a majority motion. ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/thomas-massie-pete-hegseth-impeachment-house-defense-rcna597989); [PolitiFact](https://politifact.com/article/2026/nov/09/hegseth-impeachment-house-massie-jeffries/))

**Three** of the eight charges accuse Hegseth of waging the Iran war without a declaration of war or statutory authorization (War Powers Resolution). Other charges cite alleged drug-boat strikes, the capture of Venezuela’s Nicolás Maduro, and military action in Yemen. ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/thomas-massie-pete-hegseth-impeachment-house-defense-rcna597989); [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/09/nx-s1-6034483/thomas-massie-impeachment-pete-hegseth))

House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries said Sunday he is a **“hard yes”** on the impeachment effort. ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/thomas-massie-pete-hegseth-impeachment-house-defense-rcna597989))

Hegseth said Monday he will hold a **Pentagon press conference Tuesday morning** on the impeachment effort. ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/thomas-massie-pete-hegseth-impeachment-house-defense-rcna597989))
notYetConfirmed: **Whether the privileged resolution reaches a floor vote** or is tabled / killed by a Republican majority motion before Wednesday. Outlets report both paths are available; no final procedural outcome yet. ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/thomas-massie-pete-hegseth-impeachment-house-defense-rcna597989); [PolitiFact](https://politifact.com/article/2026/nov/09/hegseth-impeachment-house-massie-jeffries/))

**How many Republicans would join Democrats** if a floor vote is held. PolitiFact notes analysts’ vote-math scenarios; Rep. Don Bacon (R-Neb.) has said he is undecided. These are projections, not a counted whip. ([PolitiFact](https://politifact.com/article/2026/nov/09/hegseth-impeachment-house-massie-jeffries/))

**Whether a House passage would lead to Senate conviction/removal.** No Senate trial schedule exists; conviction would require a two-thirds Senate vote under the Constitution (standard impeachment process — not yet triggered).
related: After meeting Qatar’s prime minister, President Trump told reporters Monday the war in Iran is **“militarily effectively over”** and that the U.S. is keeping a “status quo,” while saying forces remain ready if circumstances change. ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-war-trump-qatar-c38770b168faf5e094e96c1e1e212cff); [Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/11/09/trump-says-he-sees-no-need-new-military-strikes-against-iran/))
whatHappensNext: **Tuesday morning:** Hegseth Pentagon press conference on the impeachment effort.
**By Wednesday, Nov. 11:** House must consider the privileged resolution unless it is killed by a majority motion.
If the House approves articles, the matter goes to the Senate for trial.
